skills_considered.reason: The supplied HTML was complete and fingerprinted; retrieval was limited to figures and the missing supplement.
The paper establishes model conflicts and cancer susceptibility, not a therapeutic hypothesis for the disease model.
ENU is an experimental mutagen and no intervention is proposed.
Canonical promotion and BATCH_COMMIT remain reserved for the operator.

group_assessment.weighting: PubMed ESearch on 2026-08-11 returned 137 Aqeilan RI author records and 64 WWOX title/abstract records. This group created the knockout and is primary for WWOX experimental oncology. That strengthens provenance for the allele and observations but not the morphology-only osteosarcoma interpretation, which conflicts with an independent null series.

queries.query: WWOX AND (mouse OR mice) AND knockout

field_density.note: The broader knockout and heterozygote literature is established, but this paper's juvenile osteosarcoma finding remains contradicted by PMID 19936220 rather than settled by density.

multihop.note: All 28 references and PMIDs were enumerated. No new load-bearing paper is silently introduced. The p73 interaction paper PMID 15070730 remains the operator-assigned optional fifth and was not opened in this four-paper perimeter.

corpus_crossquery.query: Where does PMID 17360458 occur, and how does its positive osteosarcoma series compare with the already-read negative null series?
corpus_crossquery.note: Twenty-two disease-model files contain the PMID, including FT-032/FT-063 and the PMID 19936220 dossier. The read confirms the source of the 4/13 claim but leaves it conflicting because it is morphology-only and the later 0/9 series used multiple modalities.

retraction_check.result: Repository retraction preflight on 2026-08-11 returned no retraction or expression-of-concern flag for PMID 17360458.

entries.proposition: The engineered allele abolishes measured protein and causes complete pre-weaning mortality.

entries.proposition: The juvenile osteosarcoma claim rests on four morphology-positive animals among thirteen nulls.
